setName: 2026 Bowman Mega Box Baseball insert subsets (Bowman Prospects Mega Autographs, Bowman Rookies Mega Autographs, Bowman Sterling Chrome Mojo, Electric Sluggers Chrome Mojo)
mintedBy: Split out of the sibling base-ladder package (acq-2026-09-21-checklistinsider-bowman-mega-box-mojo-ladder-2026/) after independent review found the original single file wrongly absorbed these four insert subsets' cards into the base-card Mojo ladder with every BMA-/RMA- autograph row incorrectly carrying isAuto=false. Each subset here has its own stated roster and its own stated parallel ladder (confirmed on the source page, distinct print-run bands from the base ladder), and is filed under its own category so it never collides with the base BCP-/numeric cards.
registeredKeyNote: No new productSetKeys.ts registration needed -- BST- rows already exist in card_catalog under setKey=bowman-mega (confirmed: 46 existing BST- rows found there, source checklistinsider-2026-08-27/beckett-s3-2026-09-19), so all four subsets here are filed under the same already-registered bowman-mega key via their own `category` value, matching the existing convention for this product's insert subsets.

cpaCraMfPrefixes.reason: The source page states NO 'Parallels:' ladder for any of these three sections -- confirmed by direct HTML inspection immediately around each heading; MF- lists only its 25-card roster and pack odds with zero parallel names anywhere; CPA-/CRA- ('Image Variation Autographs') likewise list only rosters. Not staged anywhere in this PR per no-synthetic-parallels doctrine.

spellingAudit: Parallel names taken verbatim from each subset's own stated ladder on the source page. Cross-checked against card_catalog's existing bowman-mega spellings for the same colour words (identical -- Purple/Blue/Aqua/Green/Gold/Orange/Black & White/Black/Red/Rose Gold/Burgundy/Pink Mojo Refractor all already present under this setKey).
selectCardsOnlyAudit: No 'select cards only' language on any of the four subset sections; each ladder applies to its full named roster.

provenance.cardsFrom: checklistinsider.com xlsx workbook rosters, restricted to the BMA-/RMA-/BST-/ES- prefixes (60/10/15/25 = 110 distinct card numbers, cross-verified against the HTML page's own card-by-card lists for each section -- no duplicates found within these four prefixes, unlike the base 100-card roster)
provenance.rungsFrom: each subset's own stated parallel ladder on the source page, verbatim, with print runs
provenance.isAutoFrom: each section's own heading -- 'Bowman Prospects Mega Autographs' and 'Bowman Rookies Mega Autographs' are stated autograph inserts (isAuto=true); 'Bowman Sterling Chrome Mojo' and 'Electric Sluggers Chrome Mojo' carry no 'Autograph' designation on the page and are standard insert cards (isAuto=false)
provenance.dedup: existing card_catalog rows for setKey=bowman-mega, sport=baseball, cardYear=2026, cardNumber prefix in (BMA-,RMA-,BST-,ES-) were checked and any (cardNumber, parallel) pair already present was excluded -- 188 of the 1,045 theoretical rows were already covered.
